posts.title: Hubris reports go here
posts.author: Nemesis
posts.body:
Several of you have been sending me private messages about other members. Stop. Post them here, where the accused can see them. Retribution is not gossip.

What I need:
  • What they did
  • Why they thought they could
  • Whether it has already been balanced
What I do not need is your opinion on whether they deserve it. Deserving is my department.

posts.author: Achilles
posts.body: Reporting Odysseus. Blinded Polyphemus, then shouted his full name and home address from the boat. Textbook.

posts.author: Odysseus
posts.body: Reporting Achilles. Dragged Hector's body around the walls of Troy for days on end because he was upset.

posts.author: Nemesis
posts.body: Balanced. One arrow, in the heel, from Paris of all people. The choice of archer was deliberate. Next.

posts.author: Poseidon
posts.body: Reporting Odysseus. Again. The ten years were not enough. He is still telling the story at feasts and he makes me sound petty.

posts.author: Nemesis
posts.body:
Duplicate. Balanced. Being made to sound petty is not an offense, it is a description.

Report dismissed.
